lyrics:
[Intro: simple piano figure, soft pad]

[Verse 1: high clear male tenor, gentle]
Another lobby, another key card in a sleeve
Same carpet, same painting of the sea
The ice machine is humming down the hall
I'm lying here composing this to you

[Verse 2: bass and light drums enter]
They ask me at the bar if I get lonely
I say I've got a call at nine o'clock
You tell me what the dog did, what the mail brought
And I can see the kitchen while you talk

[Chorus: full band, voice soaring]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Verse 3: voice warmer, guitar answering]
Twenty years of airports and of rental cars
Of birthdays on a screen, I know the cost
But you have never once asked me to prove it
And I have never once been lost

[Chorus: full band, harmonies]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Guitar Solo: singing lead guitar, wordless vocal over it]
Whoa-oh-oh, oh-oh
Whoa-oh-oh, oh-oh

[Final Chorus: biggest, last word held]
Room two-fourteen, yours as always
Different city, same old vow
I count the nights in little soaps and coffee
I'm still yours, I'm still yours now
Home by Friday
Yours, as always

[Outro: piano figure, a phone ringing once, "Hey. It's nine."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 65 BPM, 4/4, B major. Slow, warm and steadily building, the classic shape of the form.

VOICE: Male tenor, high, clear and ringing, with a slight rasp when he pushes. Gentle in the verses, soaring in the choruses, and wordless over the guitar solo. He holds the last word of the final chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A piano playing a simple repeating figure, a warm synth pad, bass, a drum kit entering gradually and opening up in the choruses, a singing lead guitar with long sustain, a string pad, backing harmonies.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro piano. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Verse 2. 1:20 Chorus 1. 1:56 Verse 3. 2:28 Chorus 2. 3:04 Guitar solo with wordless vocal. 3:32 Final chorus. 4:08 Outro, one ring and a greeting, ends 4:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-1980s arena rock ballad: warm, wide and polished, piano and voice leading, guitar and drums growing.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I count the nights in little soaps and coffee' at 1:36.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a rock star on a tour bus. Far more people live this life in business hotels with a lanyard and a rental car, and their faithfulness is a phone call at nine.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Lonely, connected, grateful, steadfast.
